# Issues & Feedback

Thanks for using MARIHAR and taking the time to share your feedback!

Bug reports, feature ideas, and questions from the community help make MARIHAR better. Every contribution, no matter how small, is welcome!

## Before Opening an Issue

A few quick checks will help us investigate your issue more efficiently:

- **Search existing issues** — Your bug or idea may already have been reported. If so, add a comment to the existing issue instead of opening a duplicate.
- **Update first** — Make sure you are using the latest available release of MARIHAR and the latest supported version of yt-dlp.
- **Describe the problem** — Include your MARIHAR version, Windows version, the steps to reproduce the issue, and relevant download settings.
- **Provide details** — Attach screenshots or include relevant error messages from the application's console log. Avoid sharing private URLs or sensitive information.

## What You Can Open

| Type | Use it for |
|---|---|
| **Bug Report** | Crashes, failed or stalled downloads, and unexpected behavior |
| **Feature Request** | New platforms, language support, audio track selection, subtitle features, and new capabilities |
| **Improvement** | Ideas to make existing features more reliable, efficient, or user-friendly |
| **Question** | Help with installation, configuration, or application usage |

## Security Issues

Please **do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues**.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature, if enabled for this repository, to report security concerns confidentially.

## Contributing

Found a bug and know how to fix it? Pull requests are welcome!

Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup instructions and contribution guidelines.

Thank you for helping make MARIHAR more reliable, accessible, and useful for everyone!
